knowledge-base.overview: Micronaut 4.x guardrails, compile-time DI patterns, HTTP controllers, data repositories, configuration, error handling, and testing. Applies to microservices, serverless, and CLI apps targeting Java 21+. Loaded automatically when agents work on Micronaut .java or .kt projects.

core-principles.principle: All dependency injection is resolved at compile time — no reflection at runtime. This enables native image support and sub-100ms startup.
First-class native image support for fast startup and minimal memory footprint in containers and serverless.
Built-in reactive programming with non-blocking I/O; use @ExecuteOn(BLOCKING) only when needed.
Service discovery, distributed tracing, and config management are first-class features.
Use jakarta.inject annotations, not Spring-specific ones.

guardrail.rule: Use constructor injection exclusively. Field injection is not compile-time verifiable and breaks native image builds. Never use @Autowired.
Never use reflection-based libraries (Jackson polymorphism, dynamic proxies) without explicit GraalVM reflect-config. Prefer @Serdeable and compile-time serialization.
Never expose domain entities directly in API responses. Always use @Serdeable record DTOs and a MapStruct mapper.
Never hardcode secrets, API keys, or passwords. Reference via ${ENV_VAR:default} in application.yml.
Apply @ExecuteOn(TaskExecutors.BLOCKING) on controllers or service methods that perform JDBC or other blocking I/O. Never block reactive threads without this annotation.
Use @Transactional at the service layer, not the repository layer. Use @Transactional(readOnly = true) for read-only operations.
Use Flyway or Liquibase for schema migrations. Never use schema-generate: create in any non-throwaway environment.
Paginate all list endpoints. Never return unbounded collections — extend PageableRepository and accept a Pageable parameter.
Add Jakarta validation annotations (@NotBlank, @Email, @Size) to all DTO fields. Apply @Validated at the controller class level.
Use @Requires for conditional bean loading per environment (dev/production). Keep environment-specific beans separate from core beans.

project-structure.description: Standard Micronaut project layout with compile-time DI, repositories, and DTOs.
project-structure.example: myapp/ ├── src/main/ │ ├── java/com/example/ │ │ ├── Application.java # Entry point with @OpenAPIDefinition │ │ ├── config/ # @Factory, @ConfigurationProperties beans │ │ ├── controller/ # @Controller classes (@Validated) │ │ ├── service/ # Business logic interfaces │ │ │ └── impl/ # Service implementations (@Singleton) │ │ ├── repository/ # @JdbcRepository interfaces │ │ ├── domain/ # @MappedEntity classes │ │ ├── dto/ # @Serdeable record DTOs │ │ ├── mapper/ # MapStruct @Mapper (componentModel = "jsr330") │ │ └── exception/ # Custom exceptions + ExceptionHandler impls │ └── resources/ │ ├── application.yml # Main config (+ -dev.yml, -prod.yml overrides) │ ├── db/migration/ # Flyway SQL files │ └── logback.xml ├── src/test/java/com/example/ # Unit + @MicronautTest integration tests ├── build.gradle # Micronaut Gradle plugin └── settings.gradle

notes.note: service/impl/ separates interface from implementation for testability
dto/ uses @Serdeable records — immutable and native-compatible
mapper/ bridges domain entities to DTOs via MapStruct with jsr330 component model
exception/ bundles custom exceptions with their ExceptionHandler implementations

rules.rule: Use @MicronautTest for integration tests — starts embedded server with full DI
Use @MockBean for replacing DI beans in integration tests
Use TestPropertyProvider to inject dynamic Testcontainer config before server start
Name tests to describe behavior: shouldCreateUserWhenEmailIsUnique

quick-reference.item: Constructor injection only — compile-time verified, native-compatible; @Factory for third-party objects
@Serdeable records with Jakarta validation annotations — immutable and native-safe
@ExecuteOn(TaskExecutors.BLOCKING) on controllers handling JDBC; never block reactive threads
@Transactional at service layer only; @Transactional(readOnly = true) for reads
@JdbcRepository extends PageableRepository; derived query methods preferred over @Query
@MicronautTest + TestPropertyProvider + Testcontainers for integration; @MockBean for overrides
Field injection, @Autowired, mutable DTOs, unbounded list responses, schema-generate: create
